65: Blessings are divided into four categories: Blessings of prayer, blessings over commandments, blessings for enjoyment, and blessings of praise and thanks. We have already written the blessings of prayer and the blessings over commandments, which have a set time in the year, in their place. And I have seen [fit] to divide the blessings for enjoyment, the blessings of praise and thanks and the blessing over commandments that do not have a set time but are rather contingent, such as circumcision and marriage, into nine chapters.
